errors.claim: Combat power components include tangible factors such as numbers and materiel.
errors.source_check: In the Combat Power section (source lines 1728-1763) the only tangible/easily-measured factor named is 'superior numbers' (line 1730). 'materiel' occurs only once in the whole source, at line 810, inside the separate 'Physical, moral, and mental forces' list ('losses of materiel or life... prisoners or materiel captured'), not as a stated component of combat power. Adding 'materiel' to the combat-power tangibles is a small unsupported extension; not contradicted, since materiel is a physical/tangible factor elsewhere, hence MINOR-DRIFT.
